name: Command Aura's ally buff 537248 procs once it has a spell_proc row (#3716, partial)
contract: Command Aura 524600 effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE, target TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID (radius index 12), triggering 537248 on nearby allies. 537248 ('Command Aura', the buff allies carry) is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (231) on 537249 'Stormstrike Damage' (SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, SchoolMask 9 Normal+Nature), with EffectSpellClassMask entirely zero - no family restriction, matching 'when they deal direct damage' for any ally. Spell.dbc ships ProcFlags 0 for 537248 and no spell_proc row exists anywhere in the tree, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs never builds an entry ('Skip if no proc flags in DBC') and Aura::GetProcEffectMask returns 0, meaning the aura can never fire. Same class of defect, same shape, as the nine sibling fixes in rev_20260921_40_ranger_dead_procs.sql; this record was missed by that pass. The new spell_proc row supplies ProcFlags 340 (PROC_FLAG_DONE_MELEE_AUTO_ATTACK | PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_MELEE_DMG_CLASS | PROC_FLAG_DONE_RANGED_AUTO_ATTACK | PROC_FLAG_DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS) - any direct melee or ranged damage done. Expected: once the ally carries 537248 and lands a melee auto-attack on the dummy, Stormstrike Damage (537249) is recorded from the ally against it. Before the fix no such damage is ever recorded no matter how long the ally attacks. Partial: this proves the proc event only. 537249 is cast with the value threaded from 524600's EffectBasePoints -1 (0), and nothing computes the tooltip's $RAP*0.35 from the Ranger's stats, so the Stormstrike Damage itself deals 0; that half needs a maintainer decision (whose attack power, across the ally-cast chain).

steps.label: SETUP: the ally received the Command Aura buff
CONTRACT: the revived 537248 proc fires on the ally's direct damage
